issues.location: file identity for Using Definitions in the Methods/Proofs chapter
issues.finding: The source uses olfileid{mod}{prf}{def}, while the parent part uses mth and all nine other Proofs section files use mth/prf. The mismatched part key risks an inconsistent reader identity and reference namespace.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use olfileid{mth}{prf}{def} for this section, retaining its chapter and section keys.

translation_treatment: The target uses the established mth/prf identity and translates the definitions lesson, preserving math and term-token order. The frozen source remains unchanged.
